description: AI Agents: Use when the person wants something to keep happening by itself in one system, such as "when a deal is won, add a kick-off task". Writes one rule (when, only if, then) on one record type and returns it as a sentence, what it would have done in the last 30 days and an approval link; nothing runs yet. After their yes, call set_automation_status with approve; a rule that sends something is only switched on through the link. Field keys come from describe_record_type. Not for a one-off change (use a propose_ tool) or for syncing two systems (use plan_integration).

arguments.description: For a propose_ action: one item of that tool with {record.id} as its id; {record.contact}, {record.deal}, {record.job}, {record.owner} and {action1.id} name other records. notify: to, text, subject. email_contact: subject, body, sender_name and reply_to; ask the person for the last two.

clear.description: For set_fields: field keys to empty.

kind.description: set_fields, create_record, notify, email_contact (approved on its page only), or a propose_ tool's action without the prefix, such as add_task.

set.description: For set_fields and create_record: field keys and values. Values may use {record.id}, {today}, {today+3} and {record.field:Amount}.

type.description: For create_record: the record type to make.

apply_to_existing.description: Also act once on records that already match.

conditions.description: Only if: conditions that must all hold.

value.description: Not for empty and not_empty; a number for above and below.

name.description: A short name for the rule.

replaces.description: Optional id of an automation this rule replaces once approved.

system.description: The AI agent: its system or connection name.

days.description: For date_reached: days after the date, negative for before. For unchanged_for: days without a change.

field.description: The field key. For becomes, changes and date_reached.

kind.description: created, becomes (a field gets a value), changes, date_reached, unchanged_for, tag_added or tag_removed.

value.description: For becomes: the value it gets. For unchanged_for: the value it holds. For a tag trigger: the tag.

yearly.description: For date_reached: every year, such as a birthday.

type.description: The record type, such as contact or invoice.

name: propose_automation
title: Propose an automation
